name: Create Anesthesia
script:
# Create Anesthesia docs from Patient Encounter -> Procedure Prescription

# rows = doc.get("procedure_prescription") or []
# if not rows:
#     return

for row in doc.procedure_prescription:
    frappe.errprint(row.procedure)
    procedure = (row.get("procedure") or "").strip()
    if not procedure:
        continue

    # Only if procedure is a Clinical Procedure Template
    if not frappe.db.exists("Clinical Procedure Template", procedure):
        continue

    # Prevent duplicates (needs patient_encounter field in Anesthesia)
    already = frappe.db.exists("Anesthesia", {
        "patient_encounter": doc.name,
        "procedure_template": procedure,
        "docstatus": ("!=", 2),
    })
    if already:
        continue

    anesthesia = frappe.get_doc({
        "doctype": "Anesthesia",
        "patient": doc.patient,
        "patient_encounter": doc.name,     # add this Link field in Anesthesia
        "procedure_template": procedure,
        "practitioner": doc.get("practitioner"),

        # Mandatory Yes/No selects: set valid option values (match your field options)
        "investigations": "No",
        "consent_form": "No",
        "anesthesia_type": "Local",
        "fit_to_surgery": "No",
    })
    anesthesia.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

name: Check Paid Amount
Anesthesia Package
script:
# ✅ Safety: if sales order already submitted, don't do anything
if doc.get("sales_order") and frappe.db.exists("Sales Order", doc.sales_order):
    existing = frappe.get_doc("Sales Order", doc.sales_order)
    if existing.docstatus == 1:
        frappe.publish_realtime("new_msg")
        raise SystemExit

# Load/create Sales Order
so_name = doc.get("sales_order")
if so_name and frappe.db.exists("Sales Order", so_name):
    so = frappe.get_doc("Sales Order", so_name)
else:
    so = frappe.new_doc("Sales Order")
    so.source_order = "Anaesthesia"

# Header
so.delivery_date = frappe.utils.getdate()
so.so_type = "Cashiers"
so.ref_practitioner = doc.practitioner
so.anaesthetist = doc.anaesthetist

customer = frappe.db.get_value("Patient", doc.patient, "customer")
if not customer:
    frappe.throw("Please set a Customer linked to the Patient")
so.customer = customer

updated_refs = []
package_summaries = []

# Build items from packages
for row in doc.get("packages_prescription") or []:
    if not row.package:
        continue

    pkg = frappe.get_doc("Package Template", row.package)
    pkg_qty = row.qty or 1
    item_bits = []

    for line in pkg.get("package_prescription") or []:
        if not line.item:
            continue

        ref = row.name

        # find-or-create SO item by reference_dn
        so_item = None
        for r in so.get("items", []) or []:
            if (r.reference_dn or "") == ref:
                so_item = r
                break
        if not so_item:
            so_item = so.append("items", {})

        so_item.reference_dt = row.doctype
        so_item.reference_dn = ref

        so_item.item_code = line.item

        line_qty = line.get("qty") or 1
        line_rate = line.get("rate") or 0

        so_item.qty = pkg_qty * line_qty
        so_item.rate = line_rate

        updated_refs.append(ref)
        item_bits.append(f"{line.item} x{so_item.qty}")

    if item_bits:
        package_summaries.append(f"{pkg.name}: " + ", ".join(item_bits))

# ✅ Keep only rebuilt rows (prevents duplicates on re-run) - SAFE EXEC VERSION
new_items = []
for r in (so.get("items") or []):
    if (r.reference_dn or "") in updated_refs:
        new_items.append(r)
so.items = new_items

summary_text = "; ".join(package_summaries)
# avoid hasattr in server script if it complains; but usually it works
if "comment" in so.as_dict():
    so.comment = summary_text
else:
    so.customer_remarks = summary_text

if not so.get("items") and not so.name:
    raise SystemExit

so.flags.ignore_links = 1
so.flags.ignore_validate_update_after_submit = 1
so.flags.ignore_validate_update_after_submit = 1
so.flags.ignore_permissions = 1

if not so.name:
    so.insert()
    so.submit()
else:
    if so.docstatus == 0:
        so.save()
        so.submit()

if doc.get("sales_order") != so.name:
    doc.db_set("sales_order", so.name, update_modified=False)

# frappe.publish_realtime("new_msg")
